job.title: Staff Software Engineer in Test
job.pay_full: $184,000 – $253,000 a year base salary (San Francisco Bay Area), plus equity (where applicable), bonus and benefits

details.about: Okta secures identity for people and AI, building trusted, neutral infrastructure for organizations. This Staff Software Engineer in Test joins the QA Core engineering team, which handles release-based testing and validation and builds test services that let other teams automate. The team works with Infrastructure, Release Engineering, Release Management, Technical Operations and Engineering Leadership so that Okta's weekly releases across all services ship on time and with high quality.
duties: Analyze and refine requirements with development and engineering leads, and scope and plan test efforts
Design and implement robust, scalable test solutions
Work in a scrum team and manage deliverables with minimal supervision
Partner with development and release teams on infrastructure growth and high availability
Review new changes going into test and staging and make sure they work with existing customer deployments
Develop new test services for release readiness and validation
Turn top customers' usage patterns into automated or manual test requirements
Develop and run end-to-end/system test plans and maintain test configurations
needs: 5+ years in software QA focused on release-based testing
5+ years working on both the server and client side of device technology
5+ years with some of: Selenium (preferably with Java), TestNG, log management tools (Splunk/Sumologic/Kibana), Docker, Kubernetes
5 years writing SQL and testing or building integrated scenarios
5 years of Java-based test automation development
5 years developing and executing end-to-end or system test plans
5 years setting up and maintaining test configurations and lab environments
B.S. or M.S. in computer science, computer engineering, software engineering or a closely related field
4–7 years of experience as a quality engineer or software engineer
details.benefits: Base salary $184,000 – $253,000 a year for candidates in the San Francisco Bay Area; actual pay depends on skills, qualifications, experience and location. Okta also offers equity (where applicable), a bonus and benefits including health, dental and vision insurance, a 401(k), a flexible spending account and paid leave (including PTO and parental leave).
notes: New hires start with an in-person onboarding experience
Accommodations are available for any part of the application, interview or onboarding process
